speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: I brought ale. Mother says you are to drink it lying, which is a skill. And I want to know how a king is put down on a stage.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sit on the floor if you sit. The bed is a lie. I tried it this morning, and the floor won.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: A king, though. You have written one. Nick Sorrell's scarce older than I, and he wears taffeta before the Queen. Why must the putting-down of a king be a thing I only hear about over ale?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Because you are here, and he is there, and nothing has been arranged to move you. The Master of the Revels has cut the scene that showed it. It is not played. I am not writing it back to please a brother on a floor.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: Cut. The best of it, I should think.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The best of it for a crowd, and the worst of it for a company that means to keep a licence. You may know it was cut. You may not play it in the yard to show you know. Finish school.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: Let me read a cue, then. One. You can write the answer with the hand that still works, and I will see how a line is born when a man cannot sit up to bow to it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Read the word before the speech, not the speech. The speech is already born. I am only making three lines fair, one-handed, so Sunday's blot does not go to London as a blot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is a name, not a cue, and it will do. Stay while I write three. Then school, Edmund. Admiring a play is not a living, and I have not promised you one.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: I did not say I would be a chief player. I said I would begin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Begin at the grammar. The ale was kind. Leave me the cup, and take the wish downstairs with you.
